_comment: Triage settings (issues #11, #12, #33). green_threshold / yellow_threshold are only the display scale: the calibrated list threshold is shown as green_threshold, the start of yellow as yellow_threshold. label_periods and list_factor belong to `triage.cli relevance` (docs/ISSUE_RECALL.md): quarters with known Suva selection, and the multiplier on the F2 threshold (1.0 = best F2, lower = longer list and higher recall; 0.3 found all 59 Suva judgements of the two labelled quarters). The relevance value is shown on this file's 0-100 scale: list threshold = green_threshold. target_recall (#75) replaces list_factor when set: the list threshold is the highest value at which that share of the known Suva judgements of the labelled periods is on the list (0.95 = 95 %; why each threshold sits where it does is stored as basis in the calibration file and shown in the UI); yellow_recall sets the lower bound of yellow the same way (1.0 = every known Suva judgement at least yellow). Set target_recall to null to use list_factor again.
